title: Swap the Mining Laser I for a Mining Laser II at Ironlight Crossroads, LHS 1140 (fit with replace), Voidborn-born miners, three at a time
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-23 05:26 UTC (orders ENT-076, block ZERO: fit the stronger lasers where three results prove them; rules F3, F7, F12, F17, F37). The Laser II is proven on three results and more: 10 gather runs by 7 Solarian ships after their fit at Sol (runs.jsonl 03:10 to 05:15 UTC) mined 404 ore an hour at Lacaille against 234 for a Laser I (27 runs), 361 against 267 at Markab, 338 against 200 at Nihal. Ironlight Crossroads asks 2,404 cr x 20 for it (table books, read 05:23 UTC), the cheapest in the galaxy; Sol Central's 2,500 is bought out. For the Voidborn miners that the Laser III route (10 asks at 5,731) does not reach. LHS 1140 is lawless, six jumps from home, a public station of the Ironlight Combine: an empty hold (rule F3). Only the Laser I is replaced; an Ice Harvester stays. max_pilots 20 = the asks; min_credits 12,000 keeps the pilot above the wallet top-up line after the buy (F7). requires.empire voidborn: the other empires' newborns stay home (P6). The ask gate stops it when the asks are gone.
